mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the weather is currently 67 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. We have a third quarter moon tonight, and the temperature will dip to an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain expected.

October has been proclaimed Community Planning Month in Verona to honor the Planning and Development Department for their dedication. Also, a reminder that the tri-shaw Bike Program at the Senior Center is accepting signups for free, guided rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.
We have a packed schedule today, including the World Dairy Expo, live music at Bailey's Run, and the Farley Center Fall Festival. Tomorrow, you can catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.
In our police report for the week, on September 21, officers identified a subject via surveillance footage who was subsequently cited for retail theft.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Andes Mint Avalanche. The restaurant is open and serving guests until 10 PM, so make sure to stop by soon.
